description: [Corrective Repair] Hydraulic cylinder overhaul and seal pack replacement. Isolate manifold blocks, depressurize accumulator, replace blown rod seals and Glyd rings, flush hydraulic lines, top up ISO VG 46 mineral oil, and perform 250 bar pressure holding test. Assigned to Vikram Patel (Hydraulic & Pneumatic Systems).

[Corrective Overhaul] Emergency spindle bearing replacement. Dismantle front/rear bearing caps, extract seized SKF/NSK bearings, clean housing bore, install replacement matched bearing set with dynamic interference fit, repack with synthetic high-temp grease, and verify vibration baseline under stepped load. Assigned to Rajesh Sharma (Vibration & Rotor Dynamics).

[Corrective Alignment] Motor overhaul and flexible coupling replacement. Decouple drive motor from planetary reducer, replace sheared elastomeric spider element, perform laser shaft alignment within 0.05 mm tolerance, check winding insulation resistance, and verify phase current symmetry. Assigned to Suresh Kumar (Electrical Drives & Switchgear).
